title: Finite type of a fixed-rank kernel on one open intersection
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $U,W\subseteq X$ opens, and $n\in\mathbb N$. Restriction is as in [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. Assume that for every open $V\subseteq U$ and every map $\mathcal O_V^{\oplus n}\to (F|_U)|_V$, the kernel is of finite type (locally generated by finitely many sections). For a map $f:\mathcal O_W^{\oplus n}\to F|_W$, the restriction of $\ker f$ to $W\cap U$, regarded as the object $W\cap U\to W$ of the slice site, is of finite type. No cover, surjectivity, or finite-type hypothesis on $F$ is required.

proof.text: Let V be the preimage of W in U and Z its image in X; Z = W intersection U. Restrict the map f using overMap for Z -> W. Compose the equivalence between modules on the slice over Z and modules on Z.toScheme, restriction along U.ι.isoImage V, and the inverse open-slice equivalence for V. The structure-module isomorphism and mapFreeIso identify the source with the rank-n free module. The overFunctorMap, restriction composition, and isoImage identities identify the target with (F|U).over V. Define g by composing those isomorphisms with the image of f; apply hK V g.

The finiteType_equivOver, finiteType_restrict, and finiteType_equivOverInverse helpers proved in the kernel-condition restriction module transfer finite type of kernel g back through the equivalence. Prove that overMap preserves this kernel by evaluating its image cone at every slice object and using preservation of kernels by evaluation and restriction of scalars. PreservesKernel.iso and kernel.mapIso identify the image of kernel f with kernel g; the equivalence unit and finiteType_of_iso give finite type of overMap(kernel f).

Use the iterated-slice equivalence for D = (Z -> W). Its pushforward equivalence identifies overMap(kernel f) with (kernel f).over D sectionwise. The finiteType_pushforward_leftAdjoint helper transfers its finite generators through that equivalence, and finiteType_of_iso gives finite type of (kernel f).over D. The equality Z = W intersection U and proof irrelevance for morphisms of opens identify D with the slice object in the conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_kernel_intersection_finiteType
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens) (n : ℕ)
    (hK : ∀ (V : U.toScheme.Opens)
      (g : SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.over V)
        (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) ⟶ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F).over V),
      (kernel g).IsFiniteType)
    (W : X.Opens)
    (f : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over W) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) ⟶
      F.over W) :
    ((kernel f).over (Over.mk (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U ≤ W)))).IsFiniteType
